ideas.title: Google Maps cleanup service
ideas.one_liner: Local shops pay you to fix and refresh their Google Maps listing so customers can find them.
steps: Pick 20 shops nearby with unfinished profiles
Ask each owner for two referrals
first_customers: Google Maps shops with unanswered reviews
pitfalls: Never claim verified-owner status you do not have
Price the refresh plan, not one-off edits
ideas.compliance_note: Check local business-name registration before invoicing.

ideas.title: One-page website for food trucks
ideas.one_liner: Food trucks pay a small monthly fee for a simple site with their menu, schedule and map pin.
steps: Visit five local trucks at lunch
Show a live demo on your laptop
Ask for referrals to other trucks
first_customers: Food trucks found via Google Maps lunch clusters
pitfalls: Do not build custom sites per truck
Keep the menu update under ten minutes
